text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no way to run commands in this session, so I read the code and tests and checked each fix by hand. Please run the suite to confirm.

- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the days late. It now multiplies them.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added it as `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies are my choice, since the tests only check the title.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.

I didn't touch the tests.
